creatures.name: Dragon, Metallic, Gold, Young
creatures.special_attacks: breath weapon (40-ft. cone, DC 20, 6d10 fire), weakening breath
creatures.special_qualities: change shape, detect gems, fast flight

spellcasting.text: (CL 1st) 1st (4/day)—mage armor, shield; 0 (at will)—detect magic, light, mending, stabilize

creatures.feats: Alertness, Improved Critical (claw), Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack, Vital Strike
creatures.skills: Diplomacy +18, Fly +10, Heal +18, Knowledge (local, religion) +18, Perception +22, Sense Motive +22, Spellcraft +18, Swim +30

special_abilities.name: Change Shape
special_abilities.description: A very young or older gold dragon can assume any animal or humanoid form three times per day as if using polymorph.

special_abilities.name: Detect Gems
special_abilities.description: A young or older gold dragon can detect gems three times per day. This functions as locate object, but can only be used to locate gemstones.

special_abilities.name: Fast Flight
special_abilities.description: A young or older gold dragon is treated as one size category larger when determining his fly speed.

special_abilities.name: Weakening Breath
special_abilities.description: Instead of a cone of fire, a gold dragon can breathe a cone of weakening gas. Creatures within the cone must succeed on a Fortitude save or take 1 point of Strength damage per age category (Will save half).

creatures.ecology: Gold dragons are the epitome of virtue. Other metallic dragons revere their gold cousins as the agents of divine forces and the paragons of dragonkind, and often seek them for advice or aid. A gold dragon can cast cleric spells as arcane spells.

special_abilities.name: Luck
special_abilities.description: Once per day an adult or older gold dragon can touch a gem, usually one embedded in the dragon's hide, and enspell it to bring good luck. As long as the dragon carries the gem, it and every good creature within a given radius of it (10 ft. per age category) receives a +1 luck bonus on all saving throws. If the dragon gives an enspelled gem to another creature, only that bearer gets the bonus. The effect lasts 1d3 hours plus 3 hours per age category of the dragon. This ability is the equivalent of a 2nd-level spell.
